definitions.explanation: An appliance that heats water, either a gas water heater installed in a kitchen or bathroom, or an electric kettle-type device.

examples.japanese: {湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧。
⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{付|つ}けた→取り付ける：06797_toritsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We installed a water heater in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It is better to replace an old water heater early for safety reasons.

notes:
USAGE:
Often refers to a small gas water heater (⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}) installed above a kitchen sink, which was common in older Japanese apartments. Can also refer to electric water boilers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to replace a water heater)
- ⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (gas water heater)
- ⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (instant water heater)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{給湯器|きゅうとうき}→給湯器：04904_kyuutouki⟧: hot water heater — a more modern/formal term for the same appliance
- ⟦ポット→ポット：05286_potto⟧: electric pot — an appliance that boils and keeps water warm
